notes: The Sanitizer module uses Sanitize::Config::RELAXED which preserves safe HTML tags (b, p, div, a, img) while stripping dangerous elements (script, svg event handlers, javascript: protocols, style-based XSS).
The sanitize call in ChannelMessagesController is conditional on the key being present, which means omitting subject does not cause errors — backward compatible.

HiringStageMessageAutomationsController correctly does NOT permit :subject — it only permits channel_message_template_id, hiring_stage_id, frequency, and enabled. This is correct because automations reference templates, not direct message content.
The Sanitizer also adds target='_blank' and rel='nofollow' to all anchor tags, which applies equally to subjects — though subjects with HTML anchors would be unusual in practice.
Seed endpoints returned 500 during this run (server restart timing), but all tests were designed to run via rails runner without HTTP-level seed data, so this did not affect test validity.
